title: Auto transform `mermaid-example` in docs.
body: ## :bookmark_tabs: Summary `mermaid-example` blocks were not rendered in GitHub. Added a build step for docs which adds a `mermaid` block for each `mermaid-example`, so that it's rendered in Github. If anyone makes manual changes to `docs`, lint will fail indicating what to do. Resolves #3315 ## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions By parsing the AST and injecting directly, it will work for any complex structure. We could also introduce grammar & spell checks to docs in future easily. ### :clipboard: Tasks Make sure you - [x] :book: have read the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md) - [ ] :computer: have added unit/e2e tests (if appropriate) - [x] :bookmark: targeted `develop` branch
author: sidharthv96
